html:
Giveaway T&Cs

  1. Promoter: The giveaway is run by Ingenious in collaboration with selected partner brands (collectively referred to as “the Promoters”).
  2. Eligibility: This giveaway is open to UK residents aged 18 and over. No purchase is necessary. Employees of any of the Promoters or their immediate family members are not eligible to enter.
  3. Entry Requirements: By entering this giveaway, participants agree to:
    • Provide accurate and complete contact details.
    • Be subscribed to email communications from all collaborating brands listed in the giveaway promotion.
  4. Marketing Consent: By entering the giveaway, you are consenting to receive marketing communications via email from all Promoters involved. You can unsubscribe from these communications at any time by following the unsubscribe links in the respective emails.
  5. Data Protection: Your data will be handled in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and relevant UK data protection laws. Each Promoter is individually responsible for how they process and store your personal data. For more information, please refer to the privacy policies of the individual brands.
  6. Prize: The details of the prize(s) will be clearly stated in the promotional material. The prize is non-transferable, non-exchangeable, and there is no cash alternative.
  7. Winner Selection & Notification: The winner(s) will be selected at random from all eligible entries after the closing date and contacted by email. If a winner does not respond within 7 days, a new winner may be selected.
  8. General: The Promoters reserve the right to cancel or amend the giveaway and these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice. Any changes will be communicated via the giveaway platform.
